summary: Lower Promise.prototype.catch only when its dynamic invocation of the receiver's then property is proven to reach the builtin Promise path.

target.notes: Equivalent to invoking then(undefined, onRejected) only under the stated non-overridden requirements.

semantics.lookup: catch performs dynamic Invoke of then
semantics.handler: rejection reaction follows normal then semantics

caveats: If promise.then is overridden, catch must observe that property and cannot use this intrinsic helper.

tests.name: overridden then is observable
tests.expected_behavior: calls custom then; intrinsic helper rule must not match
